bug_semantics: XML intercept-url parsing reads servlet-path and supplies it as the basePath property of PathPatternRequestMatcherFactoryBean. The factory starts with a default PathPatternRequestMatcher.Builder, but Builder.basePath returns a new immutable builder. The vulnerable factory discards that returned builder, so getObject constructs the request matcher using only the endpoint pattern. A request under the declared servlet path then misses its intended authorization matcher, leaving a later permissive rule or otherwise unexercised rule to permit an authorization bypass.
